description: Updates the segment order on a company pattern

updated_order.description: Array of segment position assignments. Every segment in the pattern must be included.

segment_id.description: ID of the WBS Segment to reposition. Retrieve valid IDs from segments[].id in the GET patterns response.

position.description: Relative sort key. Segments are ordered by ascending position and renumbered 1..N server-side; any integers may be used as long as the intended order is preserved.
